name: Todoist
summary: Manage Todoist tasks, projects, sections, and labels through Composio OAuth.
description: Todoist account controls, task/project/section/label actions, and productivity statistics. Actions show consistent confirmation cards; lookups run without confirmation.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Settings -> API Keys in your Composio dashboard at app.composio.dev.

blocks.text: Save your Composio API key. Say “show my Todoist connection” to view your account status, or say “connect me to Todoist” to authorize in your browser. Say “disconnect Todoist” to unlink this installation’s connection.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.title: Connect Todoist
tools.description: Connect Todoist using Composio OAuth. Use when asked to connect or authorize Todoist. Verify a saved active connection; otherwise open browser authorization and immediately return pending with its link. To check or verify connection status without opening another tab, use connection_status.

children.text: Continue in your browser to securely link Todoist through Composio. If you’re already connected, we’ll verify your connection now.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.title: Todoist account
tools.description: Show Todoist connection status with an account status card. Use when asked about Todoist account settings, connection status, expired authorization, or account linking. Read only; does not start OAuth.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.title: Disconnect Todoist
tools.description: Disconnect this installation’s saved Todoist account, revoke its authorization when supported, and clear its local account and pending-link references. Use only when explicitly asked to disconnect or unlink Todoist. Does not delete Todoist tasks or projects.

children.text: Disconnect this installation’s saved Todoist account. You can reconnect later.
Your tasks, projects, sections, and labels will remain.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a Todoist task. Use when asked to add a task, reminder, or recurring task. Put scheduling in due_string or exactly one precise due field. Resolve project and section IDs using lookups; never guess IDs.

inputSchema.title: CreateTaskRequest

order.title: Order
order.description: Non-zero integer value used to sort tasks under the same parent.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The task's labels (list of names for personal/shared labels). Labels must already exist in Todoist; referencing non-existent labels may fail silently.

content.title: Content
content.description: Task content/title. Can contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks. Do NOT include due dates or times in this field - use due_string instead.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format relative to user's timezone. Use this for exact dates without time. For natural language dates, use due_string instead. Only one due_* field can be used at a time (except due_lang). Cannot express recurrence; one-off tasks only. Use due_string (e.g., 'every Friday') for recurring schedules.

due_lang.title: Due Lang
due_lang.description: 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for parsing due_string. Required when due_string is in a language other than English. Supported codes: da (Danish), de (German), en (English), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), fr (French), it (Italian), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), nb (Norwegian), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), pt (Portuguese), ru (Russian), sv (Swedish), tw (Traditional Chinese), zh (Chinese).

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Task duration amount as a positive integer. Must be used together with duration_unit. Use this field for task duration instead of embedding 'for X minutes' in due_string. Example: for a 15-minute task, set duration=15 and duration_unit='minute'.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Parent task ID for creating subtasks. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS or TODOIST_GET_ACTIVE_TASK.

due_string.title: Due String
due_string.description: Human-defined due date in arbitrary format. Accepts natural language expressions like 'tomorrow', 'next Monday at 3pm', 'in 2 hours', 'every Friday'. Also accepts formatted dates like 'Jan 21, 2026' or ISO dates like '2026-01-21'. Value is interpreted using local time. IMPORTANT: If the due string is in a language other than English (e.g., 'esta semana' in Portuguese, 'mañana' in Spanish, 'demain' in French), you MUST also set the due_lang field with the appropriate 2-letter language code (e.g., 'pt' for Portuguese, 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French, 'de' for German), otherwise the API will reject it with 'Invalid date format'. Do NOT include duration phrases like 'for X minutes' or 'for X days' in this field - use the separate duration and duration_unit fields instead. If duration is included, it will be automatically extracted and applied to the duration fields. Only one due_* field can be used at a time (except due_lang).

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project ID where the task will be created. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS or TODOIST_CREATE_PROJECT. If not set, task is added to the user's Inbox. Project names are not unique; always use numeric IDs.

section_id.title: Section Id
section_id.description: Section ID to put task into. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_SECTIONS.

assignee_id.title: Assignee Id
assignee_id.description: The responsible user ID for shared tasks (numeric format).

description.title: Description
examples: Need to get 2 gallons of milk from the store
description.description: Additional notes or details about the task. Can contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks. IMPORTANT: Do NOT include due dates, times, or scheduling information here - use the due_string field for natural language dates (e.g., 'tomorrow at 2pm') or due_date/due_datetime for specific dates.

due_datetime.title: Due Datetime
due_datetime.description: Specific date and time in RFC3339 format in UTC. Use this for exact date and time. Only one due_* field can be used at a time (except due_lang). Cannot express recurrence; one-off tasks only. Use due_string for recurring schedules.

duration_unit.title: DurationUnit
duration_unit.description: Units for task duration in Todoist.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a task.

children.text: Review the details, then create this task.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: Update an existing Todoist task. Find the exact task with get_active_tasks first. Include only requested changes. For a specific due date without a time, use due_date in the format Nov 13, 2026. When changing labels, pass the current task labels separately for display if available. For a follow-up before approval, revise the pending update, preserve the selected task and other pending edits, and show the confirmation again.

inputSchema.title: UpdateTaskRequest

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Full list of existing label names to assign. For an add or remove request, start with the current task labels and change only the requested names. Omit this field to keep existing labels. Use [] only when explicitly removing every label. The confirmation editor also accepts one label per line.

current_labels.description: Current task labels from the lookup, for display only when changing labels.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: The ID of the task to update.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Date without a time. Use the English short month, day, and four-digit year (e.g. Nov 13, 2026) for a readable confirmation. YYYY-MM-DD is also accepted.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Positive integer for task duration amount (how long the task takes). Must be used together with duration_unit. This is separate from due date - use due_string/due_date/due_datetime for when the task is due.

due_string.title: Due String
due_string.description: Human-readable due date string for natural language date parsing. Examples: 'tomorrow', 'next Monday', 'Jan 15 at 3pm', 'in 2 days'. Duration syntax like 'for X minutes' is automatically extracted and converted to the duration/duration_unit fields. Provide exactly one of due_string, due_date, or due_datetime per call — supplying multiple may cause silent failures. To clear an existing due date, pass 'no date'.

assignee_id.title: Assignee Id
assignee_id.description: User ID to assign the task to.

description.title: Description
description.description: New description for the task. Provide nonblank text or use clear_description to remove the description.

clear_description.description: Set to true only when explicitly asked to remove the task description. Omit description when using this option.

due_datetime.title: Due Datetime
due_datetime.description: Due date and time in RFC3339 format.

deadline_date.title: Deadline Date
deadline_date.description: Deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format (premium feature).

duration_unit.title: DurationUnit
duration_unit.description: Units for task duration in Todoist.

target_name.title: Selected target
target_name.description: Human-readable name/title from the lookup, for confirmation display only. Never invent a name or substitute it for the required ID.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating an existing task in Todoist.

children.text: Edit the list as shown or enter one label per line. Leave blank to keep current labels. Enter [] to remove all labels.

tools.name: close_task
tools.title: Complete task
tools.description: Complete a Todoist task. Use when asked to finish or check off a task. Find its ID with get_active_tasks. Recurring tasks advance to their next occurrence instead of permanently completing.

inputSchema.title: CloseTaskV1Request

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: String ID of the task to close. Regular tasks are marked complete and moved to history along with their subtasks. Tasks with recurring due dates are scheduled to their next occurrence.

target_name.title: Selected target
target_name.description: Human-readable name/title from the lookup, for confirmation display only. Never invent a name or substitute it for the required ID.

inputSchema.description: Request model for closing a task.

children.text: Review the selected task before completing it.
Recurring tasks advance to their next occurrence.

tools.name: get_active_tasks
tools.title: Get active tasks
tools.description: Read incomplete Todoist tasks. Use for a task list, tasks due today, overdue tasks, or finding IDs before updating or completing a task. Use valid Todoist filter syntax and follow next_cursor for more results. Does not retrieve completed tasks.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: List of task IDs to retrieve (alphanumeric string IDs).

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language code for parsing date/times in queries.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of tasks to return per page. Default is 50.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. This endpoint only returns INCOMPLETE tasks. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities; arbitrary text causes 400 errors. Supported filters: predefined keywords ('today', 'overdue', 'no due date', etc.), priority ('p1'-'p4'), projects ('#Name'), labels ('@Name'), relative dates ('7 days', '-7 days'), date filters ('due before: YYYY-MM-DD'), created/deadline ('created after: -14 days'), search ('search: keyword'). Operators: '&' (AND), '|' (OR), '!' (NOT). DO NOT USE: 'completed', '!completed', 'completed after' - these cause 400 errors on this endpoint (use TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE instead).

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a Todoist project or subproject. Resolve the parent ID with list_projects and clarify duplicate names. For a follow-up before approval, revise the pending project, preserve its other fields, and show the confirmation again.

name.title: Name
name.description: The project name. This is the only required field.

color.description: Todoist color name. Leave blank or omit to use the default, charcoal.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Parent project ID. If provided, creates this project as a sub-project. Can be either a string or integer ID.

view_style.title: View Style
view_style.description: View style of the project. Can be 'list' or 'board'.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the project. Optional field.

is_favorite.title: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Whether the project is a favorite for the user. Default is false.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. If provided, creates a workspace project instead of a personal project.

children.text: Review the details, then create this project.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete project
tools.description: Delete a Todoist project and its contents. Use only when explicitly asked to delete a project. First resolve its exact ID and name using list_projects. Clarify ambiguous names before proposing deletion.

inputSchema.title: TodoistDeleteProject2Request

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The ID of the project to delete. Can be numeric or alphanumeric format.

target_name.title: Selected target
target_name.description: Human-readable name/title from the lookup, for confirmation display only. Never invent a name or substitute it for the required ID.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a project using API v1.

children.text: Review the selected project before deleting it.
This also deletes every section and task in the project.

tools.name: create_section
tools.title: Create section
tools.description: Create a section inside an existing Todoist project. Use when asked to add a section. Resolve the project ID with list_projects before proposing the action.

inputSchema.title: CreateSectionV1Request

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the new section. This will be the section heading in the project.

order.title: Order
order.description: Position of the new section in the project. Lower values appear first. If not specified, the section will be added to the end.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: ID of the project to add the section to. Must be a new-format alphanumeric string ID. Legacy numeric project IDs are not supported by the v1 API.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a new section using API v1.

children.text: Review the details, then create this section.

tools.name: delete_section
tools.title: Delete section
tools.description: Delete a Todoist section and its tasks. Use only when explicitly asked to delete a section. Resolve its exact ID using list_sections within the selected project; clarify ambiguity.

inputSchema.title: DeleteSection2Request

section_id.title: Section Id
section_id.description: ID of the section to delete. This will delete the section and all tasks within it.

target_name.title: Selected target
target_name.description: Human-readable name/title from the lookup, for confirmation display only. Never invent a name or substitute it for the required ID.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a section.

children.text: Review the selected section before deleting it.
This also deletes every task in the section.

tools.name: get_productivity_stats
tools.title: Get productivity stats
tools.description: Read Todoist productivity statistics. Use for karma, completion totals, daily or weekly completion history, and productivity questions. Report only values returned by Todoist.

inputSchema.title: GetProductivityStatsRequest
inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving productivity statistics. No parameters required.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Todoist projects
tools.description: Read Todoist projects. Use when asked to show projects or to resolve project names into IDs before an approved action. Names may repeat: clarify ambiguous matches. Follow next_cursor for more results.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of projects to return per page. Defaults to server default if not provided.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Use the next_cursor value to fetch the next page of results.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.title: List Todoist sections
tools.description: Read Todoist sections, optionally restricted to a project ID. Use when asked for sections or to find the exact section ID before an approved action. Follow next_cursor for more results.

inputSchema.title: ListSectionsRequest

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of objects to return in a page. Default is 50.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results. Use the next_cursor value from a previous response.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: String ID of the project to get sections from. If omitted or null, get sections from all projects.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing sections with pagination support.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List Todoist labels
tools.description: Read personal Todoist labels and resolve label names into IDs. Use when asked to list labels or find an exact label before an update or deletion. Clarify duplicate names and follow next_cursor for more results. Use create_label, update_label, or delete_label for changes.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of objects to return in a page. Default is 50.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the next_cursor value from the previous response to get the next page of results.

tools.name: create_label
tools.title: Create label
tools.description: Create a personal Todoist label. For a follow-up before approval, revise the pending label, preserve its other fields, and show the confirmation again.

color.description: Todoist color name. Leave blank or omit to use the default, charcoal.

is_favorite.description: Whether to mark the label as a favorite. Defaults to false if omitted.

children.text: Review the details, then create this label.

tools.name: update_label
tools.title: Update label
tools.description: Update a personal Todoist label. Use when asked to rename a label or change its color, order, or favorite status. Resolve the exact ID with list_labels first, clarify ambiguous names, and send only requested changes.

label_id.description: ID of the label to update.

target_name.description: Existing label name from list_labels, for confirmation display only. Never substitute it for label_id.

name.description: New label name. Omit to leave unchanged.

color.description: New color name or numeric color code. Omit to leave unchanged.

order.description: New position in the label list. Omit to leave unchanged.

is_favorite.description: New favorite status. Omit to leave unchanged.

children.text: Review the requested changes. Other fields stay unchanged.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.title: Delete label
tools.description: Delete a personal Todoist label and remove it from every task that uses it. Use only when explicitly asked to delete a label. Resolve its exact ID and name with list_labels, clarify ambiguous names, and require confirmation. Tasks themselves are not deleted.

inputSchema.title: DeleteLabelV1Request

label_id.title: Label Id
label_id.description: The ID of the personal label to delete. All instances of the label will be removed from tasks.

target_name.title: Selected label
target_name.description: Human-readable label name from list_labels, for confirmation display only. Never substitute it for label_id.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a personal label.

children.text: Review the selected label before deleting it.
This removes the label from every task that uses it. Tasks themselves remain.
